functions.name: lockWindow
functions.description: Prevents the window from closing; onClosing fires instead.

functions.name: unlockWindow
functions.description: Allows a window locked with lockWindow to close again.

functions.name: writeUnread
functions.description: Writes the unseen new mail count to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/thunderbird-tray/unread.

events.name: onClosing
events.description: Fired (instead of closing) when a locked window tries to close.
